finalText:
**Redis outage cascaded into a full crash.**

`redis` connection dropped at `02:14:07` (`ECONNREFUSED 10.0.0.12:6379`). Every reconnect attempt failed, 12 times over 17 minutes, in [logs/app.log:511](logs/app.log:511) through [logs/app.log:716](logs/app.log:716).

With no cache, requests hit the store directly. Queue depth climbed from 52 to 568, past the max of 500, until `worker-2` hit `JavaScript heap out of memory` at [logs/app.log:717](logs/app.log:717) and the supervisor killed the whole process group at [logs/app.log:719](logs/app.log:719).

Next: check why `redis` at `10.0.0.12` stayed down for 17 minutes straight.
